ops.title: Stamp the release blob's core_version from the tag (pre-build cargo set-version)
ops.description: Cosmetic, pre-existing since 0.8.0: the wasm blob ships with the Cargo sentinel `core_version: 0.0.0` (the `version` op / `spawnllm status` footer shows `core: 0.0.0@<hash>`) because release-pypi's pre-build and release-go build the blob without stamping the workspace. Fix: prepend `cargo set-version --workspace "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"` (needs cargo-edit) to the blob build in BOTH release-pypi.yml's pre-build input and release-go.yml, mirroring release-crates.yml. The source_hash already identifies the build, so this is presentation only.

ops.text: a released wheel's _core.version()['core_version'] equals the tag version
